$comment: Repo policy: no silent network egress from a vendored skill. NOTE this file is only half the control — upstream reads it relative to process.cwd() (context.mjs updateCheckDisabledByConfig), so it covers repo-root sessions and NOT `cd site && …`. The cwd-independent control is IMPECCABLE_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1, set in .claude/settings.json `env`. Both are in place. scripts/generate-image.mjs (api.openai.com) and scripts/concept-seed.mjs (impeccable.style/api/roll) are separate opt-in commands that only run when invoked.
